# Every file in the public store repository (hostpapa/ddbbackup-terramaster),
# and where publish_terramaster.sh takes it from (DDB-447). Nothing else is
# published: a new file goes out only once it is added here, and the gate
# (publish/gate.sh) fails if the repository holds anything not listed.
#
#   deb:<path>   from the built package, so it matches the release byte for byte
#   ctl:<name>   from the package's DEBIAN control files
#   src:<path>   from the source repository (published as just "src")
#   list         this list
#
# The release workflow compares every deb:/ctl: file with the draft release's
# package before publishing it.

README.md                        src
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt          deb:usr/local/ddbbackup/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
config.ini                       deb:usr/local/ddbbackup/config.ini
ddbbackup.lang                   deb:usr/local/ddbbackup/ddbbackup.lang
images/icons/ddbbackup.svg       deb:usr/local/ddbbackup/images/icons/ddbbackup.svg
init.d/ddbbackup.service         deb:usr/local/ddbbackup/init.d/ddbbackup.service
DEBIAN/postinst                  ctl:postinst
DEBIAN/prerm                     ctl:prerm
DEBIAN/postrm                    ctl:postrm

.github/CODEOWNERS               src
.github/workflows/scan.yml       src
.github/workflows/release.yml    src
.github/scan/files.txt           list
.github/scan/gate.sh             src
.github/scan/get-gitleaks.sh     src
.github/scan/custom_rules.py     src
.github/scan/gitleaks-config.toml src
